name: Leal
description: Design and launch Apple Wallet and Google Wallet loyalty stamp cards for shops, cafés and salons. Reads a business's name, colours and logo from its website, previews card designs as real wallet passes, then saves the card, rewards, a QR signup poster and the store location. Design previews work without an account; saving signs in to Leal (free account available) with OAuth. No delete tools, no customer personal data, no billing.
author: Leal
